editorial:
Imagine being the only honest guy in a room full of liars. That is exactly where you find Judge Annibale Salvemini. He is a man of rules and honor who decides to take a hammer to the messy world of Italian politics and business. He starts throwing people in jail left and right, thinking he can clean up the city in one big sweep. The vibe is a wild mix of funny and frustrating because you see him fighting a system that just refuses to change. It feels like a game of cat and mouse, but the mouse has all the power and the cat is just a judge with a gavel.

You will love how the movie flips the script on you. The acting is top-notch, especially the way the judge goes from feeling like a hero to feeling like a victim. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the payoff is totally worth it. If you enjoy stories about the little guy fighting a big, corrupt machine, you need to see this. You should definitely try to find this on a 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best quality, or check if it is available for renting on Apple TV for a quick movie night.
endingExplained: In the end, the system wins. The judge tries so hard to be perfect that he actually makes himself a target. The corrupt people he tried to lock up find a way to turn the tables on him. He ends up being the one blamed and pushed aside. It is a sad but honest twist that shows you cannot fix a broken society just by following the rules when everyone else is cheating.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves political satires and stories about fighting the system.
